about: Direct build path mutants (internal/sketch/build/direct.go, direct_plan.go): each drops one input from an action key or the plan fingerprint. TestDirectRebuildsOnEachInput edits that input and counts the actions that must run again, and checks the executable against go build's; it builds Go (full tier).

mutants.name: direct-key-content
mutants.rule: A compile key holds every source file's content.

mutants.name: direct-key-file-name
mutants.rule: A compile key holds every source file's name: positions in the object and its export data name it.

mutants.name: direct-key-trimmed-path
mutants.rule: A compile key holds the package's trimmed directory (module path@version/rel), which -trimpath writes into every position.

mutants.name: direct-key-export
mutants.rule: A compile key holds the export data digest of every import.

mutants.name: direct-key-lang
mutants.rule: A compile key holds -lang, the go line of the package's module.

mutants.name: direct-key-tool
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the content digest of the tool that runs it.

mutants.name: direct-key-goarch
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the target architecture.
mutants.gap: Redundant on the supported targets: the level field names the architecture (GOAMD64=v1 against GOARM64=v8.0), so the target architecture row recompiles without it. Kept as defence for a target whose level variable is shared.

mutants.name: direct-key-goos
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the target operating system.

mutants.name: direct-key-level
mutants.rule: Every action key holds the architecture level (GOAMD64, GOARM64).

mutants.name: direct-link-modinfo
mutants.rule: The link key holds the build information the executable carries.

mutants.name: direct-link-extld
mutants.rule: The link key holds -extld, as cmd/go's link action ID holds the C compiler.

mutants.name: direct-link-archive
mutants.rule: The link key holds the archive digest of every linked package, not only its export data: a body edit with the same export data relinks.

mutants.name: direct-export-whole-archive
mutants.rule: An importer's compile key reads the export data only, so a body edit that keeps it does not recompile the importers.

mutants.name: direct-plan-env
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds the go variables of the environment: another GOARCH or CC makes another plan.

mutants.name: direct-plan-std
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds the standard imports: a new one makes a plan that has its archive.

mutants.name: direct-gobuild-ignored
mutants.rule: Toolchain.GoBuild selects go build, the reference path; the identity property compares against it, so it must not take the direct path.

mutants.name: direct-plan-gomod
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds every go.mod: the go line chooses the toolchain. The rows that edit a go.mod count the plan made again; a wrong executable needs a second toolchain on the host.

mutants.name: direct-plan-tags
mutants.rule: The plan fingerprint holds the build tags: they select the standard packages' files (netgo). The build tags row counts the plan made again.
